title: CircleCI: list a project's runs (no prompt)
support_note: Policy files no request for it, so there is nothing to capture. The circleci classifier (internal/circleciclassify/classifier.go Classify) answers a project-scoped `run list` with Reads only and no Writes; callbroker's serveCLI (internal/callbroker/handler.go) files a request only for a call with Writes, and runs a read under the read grant or refuses it (read grant missing, classifier refused) without ever asking. The gallery must not invent a prompt.
story: An agent lists the recent runs of an approved example-org/app project; the call runs under the workspace's read grant and the human is never asked.
